# Attempt

`schemas/records/attempt.json`

One try at a unit under a lease (docs/design/m0/05 "Attempt and fencing"), as its events project. An output is accepted only if its attempt id and fencing token match the unit's current attempt and publication is open; anything else is failed/stale_attempt. Publication is open only while running. internal/lease enforces the state machine and fencing.

## Fields of the document

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | [AttemptID](common-defs.md#attemptid) |  |
| `unit` | yes | [UnitID](common-defs.md#unitid) |  |
| `lease` | yes | [LeaseID](common-defs.md#leaseid) |  |
| `fencing_token` | yes | integer (minimum `1`, maximum `9007199254740991`) | Strictly increasing per unit; minted only by the controller. |
| `supersedes` | yes | null or [AttemptID](common-defs.md#attemptid) |  |
| `base` | yes | object ([fields](#fields-of-base)) |  |
| `status` | yes | one of `running`, `stopping`, `finishing`, `lost`, `sealed`, `completed`, `superseded` |  |
| `publication` | yes | one of `open`, `closed` | Whether outputs may still land: open only while running, closed atomically with the event that leaves running. |
| `stop_reason` | yes | null or one of `revoke`, `preempt`, `expire`, `drain`, `cancel` | Why a stop was requested, once it was. |
| `lost_reason` | yes | null or one of `stream_dead`, `agent_disconnect`, `controller_restart` |  |
| `checkpoint` | yes | null or [Digest](common-defs.md#digest) | The digest of the sealed AttemptRecord blob (records/attempt-record), once sealed. |
| `completion` | yes | null or object ([fields](#fields-of-completion)) |  |
| `superseded_by` | yes | null or [AttemptID](common-defs.md#attemptid) |  |

No other fields are allowed.

Conditional rules (8, `if`/`then`/`else` in the schema):

- when `status` `running`, then `publication` `open`; otherwise `publication` `closed`
- when `status` `stopping`, then `stop_reason` any (not `null`), `lost_reason` `null`
- when `status` `lost`, then `lost_reason` any (not `null`), `stop_reason` `null`
- when `status` one of `running`, `finishing`, then `stop_reason` `null`, `lost_reason` `null`
- when `stop_reason` any (not `null`), then `lost_reason` `null`
- when `status` one of `sealed`, `completed`, `superseded`, then `checkpoint` any (not `null`); otherwise `checkpoint` `null`
- when `status` `completed`, then `completion` any (not `null`); otherwise `completion` `null`
- when `status` `superseded`, then `superseded_by` any (not `null`); otherwise `superseded_by` `null`
